title: Đèn đường 3 giờ sáng
about: Round x8, in directions of my own choosing, as the user asked ("hãy sáng tác thêm nhiều bài nữa, hướng bạn tự đề xuất"): dark lofi: a slow, soft beat, the felt piano's chords, a deep bass on each beat, a cold pad; the glass picks out a short tune in the middle. A minor 9th colours at 72 bpm. An original piece.
